enumerate candidate U,V sets only within the current exact rho layer
score with exact full G; after Stage A verification also cross-check the incremental identity

m4.reason: The packet permits m=4 only on bounded radii when exact tractability is demonstrated, but Stage 0 does not need m=4. To prevent posthoc scope expansion, this frozen registry leaves m=4 disabled for R056-G0.

cooperative_caps.no_silent_expansion: No m>3 search may be added inside this frozen generation. A later explicit registry generation would be required and cannot be used to repair the frozen holdout/theorem statement.

forbidden_computation_behaviors: open strict holdout before theorem/counterexample ledger freeze
use finite-radius regression as theorem evidence
call a bounded failed search infinity
change m or locality semantics after seeing results
silently enable m=4 or larger cooperative counts
use circle/pi/circumference/tangent/teacher center in candidate selection
expand enumeration without checkpoint when budget is threatened
holdout_access: LOCKED until R056_THEOREM_COUNTEREXAMPLE_LEDGER_SHA256 is frozen; no construction/proof tuning may use these radii.

m1_direct_exact_program.completeness_requirement: For each reported exact rho_1(r), exhaust every admissible one-cell replacement with smaller support diameter before accepting the first minimum.
m1_direct_exact_program.goal: Compute exact rho_1(r) cheaply by direct single-cell relocation search.
m1_direct_exact_program.result_label_if_interrupted: LOWER_BOUND_ONLY; never infinity or exact minimum unless the relevant search layers are complete
m1_direct_exact_program.target_extent: through r=64 inclusive without opening holdout early

m2_m3_program.budget_rule: If exact enumeration becomes combinatorially expensive, checkpoint the exact completed rho/r/m region and return to the theorem route; do not expand m, construction radii, or holdout access to compensate.
m2_m3_program.canonicalization: Quotient candidate move classes by the D6 stabilizer of H_r only after preserving exact support diameter, topology and energy invariants.
m2_m3_program.exhaustive_claim_rule: Exact rho_m(r) is reported only if all smaller rho layers are exhaustively eliminated and the minimizing rho layer contains an admissible descent. Otherwise report the completed lower bound and exact completed region.
m2_m3_program.search_order: For each r and m, derive geometry-based candidate restrictions first; then scan support diameter rho=1,2,... in nondecreasing order.

selected_m_rho_queries.rule: Any selected fixed rho queried in Stage C must come from a theorem-derived or already-scanned integer rho layer, not from holdout behavior; such queries are diagnostic and cannot redefine D(m,rho).
